lessons.title: Mutual-aid gang arrival times are not captured
lessons.detail: Two mutual-aid gangs were requested from neighbouring circles and both worked the event, but neither crew record carries a mobilisation time, so mutual-aid gang-hours cannot be computed from the records.
lessons.carry_note: Mutual-aid gangs were requested and arrived again with no per-gang mobilisation time recorded.

lessons.title: Time to first consumer notification exceeded the two-hour target
lessons.detail: The first outage was recorded at 16:52 and the first consumer notification was issued at 19:33, an interval of 2 hours 41 minutes against a two-hour internal target.
lessons.closed_note: First consumer notification was issued 38 minutes after the first recorded outage, inside the two-hour target.

lessons.title: Outage management system link was lost with no fallback capture
lessons.detail: The link to the Asansol data centre was unavailable for 3 hours 30 minutes and no manual consumer counts were taken during the gap, leaving a hole in the restoration curve that cannot be reconstructed.
lessons.carry_note: The link held for this event, so the gap did not recur, but the manual fallback capture procedure remains undeveloped.

lessons.title: Tree contact in the Nunia canal corridor initiated the event
lessons.detail: The first outage and the largest single outage cluster both originated from tree contact in the Nunia canal corridor, which was last cleared in 2023.
